title.narrative: MIGRANT PROTECTION, RETURN AND REINTEGRATION IN NORTH AFRICA (MPRR-NA)

description.narrative:
Overall Objective: Vulnerable and stranded migrants from North Africa safely and voluntarily return to and from North Africa, and returnees sustainably reintegrate into their countries of origin.

Outcome 1: Vulnerable and stranded migrants in North Africa return home safely, voluntarily and in dignity to their respective countries of origin;

Outcome 2: Returning migrants are reintegrated in selected countries of origin

Outcome 3: Partner countries and relevant shakeholders in North Africa increasingly exercise responsibility for and manage migrant return, readmission, and sustainable reintegration.


(Reference to Action Document: ACT-60465 - Reference to Planned Contract: PC-20296 - Link to contract: Ares(2022)8247010)
